title: My Flashcards
text:
I have a box of flashcards. Each card has a picture on one side. The word is on the other side. I look at the picture and say the word.

I like to play with my flashcards. My sister and I take turns. She shows a card and I say the word. We are happy when we get it right.

questions.text: What is on one side of each card?
Who takes turns with the narrator?
What is the narrator probably doing to learn new words?
Why does the narrator enjoy playing with the cards?
options: It is fun to play with a sister
The cards make a loud noise

vocabulary.definition: a girl or woman who has the same parents as you

paragraph_translations: Tengo una caja de tarjetas didácticas. Cada tarjeta tiene un dibujo en un lado. La palabra está en el otro lado. Miro el dibujo y digo la palabra.
Me gusta jugar con mis tarjetas didácticas. Mi hermana y yo nos turnamos. Ella muestra una tarjeta y yo digo la palabra. Estamos felices cuando lo hacemos bien.
